assembly_context.name: FiveAxisRoboticArm_Assembly
assembly_context.summary: 基于SolidWorks API自动生成一个五轴串联机械臂装配体。包含底座、大臂、小臂、手腕旋转部、末端法兰及5根连接轴。所有连杆简化为带安装凸台的圆柱体，轴为标准圆柱零件。初始姿态为竖直向上伸直状态。
design_rules: All dimensions in mm, convert to meters for modeling code.
Initial pose: All links aligned along +Z axis.
Shafts are standard cylinders, length slightly larger than link width for assembly clearance.
Links are simplified as cylinders with mounting bosses at ends.

instances.name: J1 Shaft
instances.placement_notes: Inserted into Base top boss and Link1 bottom hole.

instances.name: J2 Shaft
instances.placement_notes: Inserted into Link1 top hole and Link2 bottom hole.

instances.name: J3 Shaft
instances.placement_notes: Inserted into Link2 top hole and Wrist1 bottom hole.

instances.name: J4 Shaft
instances.placement_notes: Inserted into Wrist1 top hole and Wrist2 bottom hole.

instances.name: J5 Shaft
instances.instance_role: Dummy/Placeholder for J5 if needed, or End Cap
instances.placement_notes: Note: Prompt says 5 shafts. J1-J4 connect links. J5 is wrist pitch. Usually Wrist2 rotates around its own axis or has a final flange. Assuming J5 shaft is inside Wrist2 or connects to a tool. For simplicity in this linear stack, J5 might be the axis of Wrist2 itself. However, prompt lists 'Shaft (x5)'. I will place J5 shaft concentric with Wrist2 top, potentially representing the tool mount axis.

assembly_sequence: Insert inst_link1, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j1.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_base.top_face_boss (or offset)
Insert inst_link2, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j2.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_link1.end_face_top
Insert inst_wrist1, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j3.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_link2.end_face_top
Insert inst_wrist2, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j4.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_wrist1.end_face_top

part.name: Standard Shaft
part.function: Connects links and allows rotation. Used for J1, J2, J3, J4, J5.
part.shape: Simple cylinder. Diameter 20mm. Length sufficient to pass through two mating bosses plus clearance.
assembly_relation_notes: Inserted into holes of adjacent links.
Faces may be coincident with link outer faces or floating depending on design intent (here assumed floating/concentric primarily).
standalone_modeling_instructions: Sketch circle dia 20mm on XY plane.
